payload.body: South Node square the Ascendant can make you slip into the old role in a new room. You become the peacemaker, the difficult one, the invisible one, or the person who takes over because that response once kept life manageable. A familiar role can feel natural even when nobody in the current situation asked you to play it.
payload.sourceMechanism: South Node square Ascendant can bring old, less constructive personality patterns back into the present response. Familiarity is not proof that an old personality response is still useful.
